messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore presents a compelling case for the science of climate change, using data, charts, and personal anecdotes to explain how rising temperatures threaten ecosystems, economies, and human health. |
| **An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power** | 2017 | A follow‑up to the original film, this installment focuses on policy and political action, showing how governments and individuals can take concrete steps to reduce emissions and mitigate climate impacts. |
| **Before the Flood** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels around the world to witness the effects of climate change firsthand, meeting scientists, activists, and affected communities while urging viewers to act on the crisis. |
| **The 11th Hour** | 2007 | Produced by Leonardo DiCaprio, this film examines the state of the planet’s ecosystems and offers solutions for sustainable living, featuring interviews with environmental leaders and scientists. |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** | 2019 | A concise, data‑driven overview of the science behind climate change, its impacts, and potential mitigation strategies, presented by a team of climate scientists. |

All of these films are available on major streaming platforms (Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, etc.) or can be rented/bought digitally. They provide a mix of scientific explanation, personal storytelling, and calls to action that make them accessible to a broad audience.
